Comment SLEEP for your free bedtime calculator 😴

Two extra hours in bed on Sunday feels like rest. Your body clock treats it more like a short flight east.

Shifting your sleep at weekends and snapping back on Monday is often called social jet lag. The Aviva 2025 sleep survey found only 17% of UK adults keep a regular sleep schedule.

You don't have to give up the lie-in. Keeping it to an hour is the trick.

Lie-in lover or up at the same time every day?

Save this for Sunday night, and send it to the friend who sleeps till noon at weekends.
